structural_change: QW-CB16REG 10-20 fallback (b): qfd_c_b16_fulln (same RTL, sites, fences, pins, SDC, PDN, outline, cycles) + tools/qwen_cluster/cb16_km/cb16_ckkm.tcl: every region root ck_c<c>r<r> has its register sinks split into K=clamp(N/500,12,40) compact k-means clusters (one BUFx24 local root each, one short TritonCTS tree per cluster, hard-child clock pins stay on the port net); after CTS the latest arrival of every cluster and of every hard-child clock pin (+ recorded child insertion) is measured and early groups are padded to the latest group of ALL 16 roots (so the single-cycle landing-ring reads between regions see aligned roots).  Why: fulln/fullnb/fullm one tree per root left within-region TT spread 410-813 ps (insertion 1.3-2.7 ns) and post-CTS WNS -1.4..-1.7 ns; the same method on the A0 rc11 ODBs took ck_dw/ck_de 124-273 ps -> 27-37 ps.  Buffers only.  Prior: QW-CB16A0-3 10-20: qfd_c_b16_fullm kit with ring bays as deterministic uniform FIRM lattices (fabric_sites_place_n.tcl) instead of EXCLUSIVE GPL regions -- root cause of fullmb/mr/mbr GPL-0305 = GPL stacked identical-net ring flops (145 on one point of qc_bay_77) so overflow never fell below target; same RTL, sites, edges. Prior: QW-CB16FULL: FULL 16-region landed CB16 parent, one clock region per A0, every seam crossing = a soft qfd_c_land_w1k / qfd_c_land_r1k ring (kept per-24-bit control copies, native census <= 32 loads; writer on the source root, reader on the destination root, each half in a RESERVED std-cell bay) (static D4/K2 ring, no credit), 3-deep pads = same-clock soft landing rings, xstn = CLOSED xstn(w)_safe, relays = CLOSED stn514/516; netlist = the qc_gen fabric MUT 0 with identical edge counts; A0 = diagnostic STAND-IN (no qualified A0 view). | QW-CB16A0 10-20 fullm: hard origins = CP-SAT joint station/bay solution on 43.2 (all-bit hard/soft/bank data <=405, independent replay PASS), ring bays = EXCLUSIVE legal regions (GPL owns ring cells, no FIRM ring blocks), every scalar reset/control FF at an arc-consistent legal site (all control edges <=385 planned, replay PASS); no data multicycle.
